changelog.title: Changelog — LibreHold
changelog.description: What has changed in LibreHold, newest first: the pixel map, instant games for guests, the game server, bots, the phone layout and the first version.
changelog.heading: Changelog
changelog.intro: What has changed in LibreHold, newest first. Small fixes land all the time; this page lists the changes you will notice in the game.

2026-10-26.title: A pixel map, instant games and armies on the road
2026-10-26.body:
The world map is drawn in pixel art, with forests, mountains and lakes.
Play now puts you in an hour-long instant game as a guest, with no account needed.
Armies march across the map, and you can watch them on the road.
You can send troops to meet an army on the road and fight it in a field battle.

2026-10-20.title: The village in pixel art
2026-10-20.body:
Your village is drawn in pixel art, building by building.
Panels, buttons and icons got a matching pixel look.

2026-10-19.title: The game server: accounts and shared worlds
2026-10-19.body:
The game runs on a server now, so your village is the same on every device.
Accounts with a name and a password.
Players share one world and meet each other on the map.
Changes arrive live: an attack, a finished building or a new report shows up without reloading the page.

2026-10-18.title: Bots that live in the world
2026-10-18.body:
Bot players build, raid, defend and take villages, the way people do.
Each bot keeps its own daily rhythm: it checks in, plays for a while and goes to sleep.
Bots remember who attacked them and may come back for revenge.
They are always labelled as bots.

2026-08-23.title: Phones, growing buildings and villages on the map
2026-08-23.body:
The game fits a phone screen, with panels laid out for a narrow display.
Every building changes its look as it gains levels.
Villages appear on the map, so you can see your neighbours.

2026-08-22.title: The first playable version
2026-08-22.body:
The first version you could actually play.
A village with buildings to upgrade, resources that keep coming in and troops to recruit.
Barbarian villages to attack, with a report after every battle.
